name: Postgres migrations
covers: Rerail's own rules for SQL migrations run on PostgreSQL (Prisma, Drizzle and plain SQL), from the PostgreSQL docs and migration linters' advice, for migrations that take no long locks, rewrite no large table and lose no data.

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: build an index on an existing table CONCURRENTLY, and attach a UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY constraint to it with USING INDEX
Postgres migrations practice: run CONCURRENTLY index builds and drops only where the migration runner adds no transaction

passes.text:
-- CreateIndex: alone in its migration, so no transaction surrounds it
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY "User_nickname_idx" ON "User"("nickname");

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: add a foreign key or CHECK constraint to an existing table with NOT VALID, and validate it in a later migration

caught.text:
-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD CONSTRAINT "Comment_postId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("postId") REFERENCES "Post"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;

passes.text:
-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD CONSTRAINT "Comment_postId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("postId") REFERENCES "Post"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE NOT VALID;

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: make an existing column NOT NULL only after a validated CHECK (col IS NOT NULL), so SET NOT NULL does not scan the table under lock

caught.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "User" ALTER COLUMN "phone" SET NOT NULL;

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: add a NOT NULL column to an existing table only with a constant DEFAULT, or nullable first, backfilled, then made required

caught.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Post" ADD COLUMN     "slug" TEXT NOT NULL;

passes.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Post" ADD COLUMN     "slug" TEXT;

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: add a column to an existing table without a volatile default, serial type, identity or stored generated expression

caught.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD COLUMN "publicId" UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: don't change a column's type on an existing table unless the change is a no-rewrite widening

caught.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Event" ALTER COLUMN "count" SET DATA TYPE BIGINT;

passes.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Event" ALTER COLUMN "name" SET DATA TYPE VARCHAR(255);

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: start a migration that locks an existing table with SET lock_timeout

caught.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "User" ADD COLUMN "flag" BOOLEAN;

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: rename a column, don't drop it and add a new one of the same type

passes.text:
-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Profile" RENAME COLUMN "biograpy" TO "biography";

rules.title: Postgres migrations practice: drop a column or table only after no schema.prisma field, Drizzle pgTable or raw SQL still uses it
